<box>'''OOC Note'''<br>
This is one of six sets of ritual robes designed by ''House Bourné'', a [[Sarvos|Sarvosan]] guild formed by the union of [[the League|League]] master-artisans and a [[Dawn|Dawnish]] [[weaver cabal]]. Their unique designs combine the power of [[dramaturgy]] with a deep understanding of the hearth magic of [[Dawn hearth magic#Girding|girding]]. During Winter 380YE, in conjunction with popular publication The Looking Glass, the Merchant-Prince ''Genia Bourné di Sarvos'' announced that the guild would allow any Imperial [[Crafting skills#Artisan|artisan]] to visit their estate in Sarvos and study the [[Magic_items#Schema|schemata]] detailing the six raiments, free of charge. House Bourné is an NPC group and is not represented at Anvil.

Any character can learn how to create this raiment following the normal rules - either by selecting the robe as one of their starting items, or learning it as an [[Crafting_skills#Extra Item|extra item pick]]. The only restriction is that anyone who knows how to make one of these robes ''must'' have spent a week or two studying at House Bourné in Sarvos - there is currently no other way to master the patterns which remain the proprietary knowledge of the Bourné guild.</box>
